item.title: Dallas Trash Trucks Are Scoring Homes With AI — 20,000 Flags, 57 Citations
item.description: Dallas put AI cameras on 50 sanitation trucks, and a new Dallas Morning News analysis says the system photographed more than 20,000 potential code concerns in four months while producing 57 citations at 34 properties. Puck and Kore unpack the strange collision of municipal efficiency, privacy, algorithmic scoring, human review and public trust—and why marketers should pay attention whenever invisible automation starts making visible decisions about people.
